sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS e, "county_public_safety"."Police_force" AS g, AVG("city"."Asian") AS m1 FROM "city" JOIN "county_public_safety" ON "county_public_safety"."County_ID" = "city"."County_ID"  GROUP BY "city"."County_ID", "county_public_safety"."Police_force"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
quantities: city.share of population identifying as Asian
why: average of share of population identifying as Asian per county_public_safety within county_public_safety.Police_force
index against the all average of average of share of population identifying as Asian (all level)
rank within the group by average of share of population identifying as Asian, keep the top 3
